items.source: script - the CQL script.
items.translation: script - CQL 脚本。

items.source:
Statement separators and comments will be removed before executing individual statements within the supplied
script.
items.translation: 在执行所提供脚本中的各个语句之前，将移除语句分隔符和注释。

items.source:
Execute the given CQL script using default settings for statement separators, comment delimiters, and exception
handling flags.
items.translation: 使用默认设置执行给定的CQL脚本，包括语句分隔符、注释分隔符和异常处理标志。

items.source: Execute the given CQL script.
items.translation: 执行给定的CQL脚本。

items.source: session - the CQL CqlSession to use to execute the script; already configured and ready to use.
items.translation: session - 用于执行脚本的已配置并准备就绪的 CQL CqlSession。

items.source: ScriptException - if an error occurred while executing the CQL script
items.translation: ScriptException - 如果在执行 CQL 脚本时发生错误

items.source: Split an CQL script into separate statements delimited by the provided separator string.
items.translation: 将 CQL 脚本按提供的分隔符字符串拆分为单独的语句。

items.source: statements - the list that will contain the individual statements.
items.translation: statements - 将包含各个语句的列表。

items.source: separator - text separating each statement (typically a ';' or newline character).
items.translation: separator - 分隔每个语句的文本（通常为分号或换行符）。

items.source: resource - the resource (potentially associated with a specific encoding) to load the CQL script from.
items.translation: resource - 用于加载 CQL 脚本的资源（可能关联特定编码）。

items.source: Split an CQL script into separate statements delimited by the provided separator string. Each individual statement will be added to the provided List.
items.translation: 将 CQL 脚本按提供的分隔符字符串拆分为单独的语句。每个单独的语句将被添加到提供的 List 中。

items.source: Within the script, "--" will be used as the comment prefix; any text beginning with the comment prefix and extending to the end of the line will be omitted from the output. Similarly, "/*" and "*/" will be used as the start and end block comment delimiters: any text enclosed in a block comment will be omitted from the output. In addition, multiple adjacent whitespace characters will be collapsed into a single space.
items.translation: 在脚本中，将使用"--"作为注释前缀；任何以注释前缀开头并延伸至行尾的文本都将从输出中省略。同样地，"/*"和"*/"将用作开始和结束块注释分隔符：任何包含在块注释中的文本都将从输出中省略。此外，多个相邻的空白字符将被合并为单个空格。

items.source: Read a script from the provided LineNumberReader, using the supplied comment prefix and statement separator, and build a String containing the lines.
items.translation: 从提供的LineNumberReader读取脚本，使用指定的注释前缀和语句分隔符，并构建一个包含这些行的String。

items.source: Read a script from the provided LineNumberReader, using the supplied comment prefixes and statement separator, and build a String containing the lines.
items.translation: 从提供的 LineNumberReader 读取脚本，使用指定的注释前缀和语句分隔符，并构建一个包含这些行的 String。

items.source: Default end delimiter for block comments within CQL scripts: "*/".
items.translation: CQL 脚本中块注释的默认结束分隔符为："*/"。

items.source: Default start delimiter for block comments within CQL scripts: "/*".
items.translation: CQL 脚本中块注释的默认起始分隔符："/*"。

items.source: Default prefix for single-line comments within CQL scripts: "--".
items.translation: CQL 脚本中单行注释的默认前缀："--"。

items.source: Default prefixes for single-line comments within CQL scripts: ["--"].
items.translation: CQL 脚本中单行注释的默认前缀：["--"]。

items.source: Default statement separator within CQL scripts: ";".
items.translation: CQL 脚本中的默认语句分隔符为：;。

items.source: End of file (EOF) CQL statement separator: "^^^ END OF SCRIPT ^^^".
items.translation: 文件结束（EOF）CQL 语句分隔符："^^^ END OF SCRIPT ^^^"。

items.source: Fallback statement separator within CQL scripts: "\n".
items.translation: CQL 脚本中的备用语句分隔符："\n"。

items.source: Does the provided CQL script contain the specified delimiter?
items.translation: 提供的 CQL 脚本是否包含指定的分隔符？

items.source: separator - the script statement separator; defaults to ";" if not specified and falls back to "\n" as a last resort; may be set to "^^^ END OF SCRIPT ^^^" to signal that the script contains a single statement without a separator.
items.translation: separator - 脚本语句分隔符；若未指定，则默认为 ";"，并在最后尝试回退至 "\n"；可设置为 "^^^ END OF SCRIPT ^^^" 以表明脚本仅包含一个无需分隔符的语句。

items.source: ScriptException - if an error occurred while splitting the CQL script.
items.translation: ScriptException - 如果在拆分 CQL 脚本时发生错误。

items.source: blockCommentStartDelimiter - the start block comment delimiter; never null or empty.
items.translation: blockCommentStartDelimiter - 块注释的起始分隔符；绝不能为 null 或空。

items.source: blockCommentEndDelimiter - the end block comment delimiter; never null or empty.
items.translation: blockCommentEndDelimiter - 块注释结束分隔符；绝不能为 null 或空。

items.source: ScriptException - if an error occurred while splitting the CQL script
items.translation: ScriptException - 如果在拆分 CQL 脚本时发生错误。

items.source: lineNumberReader - the LineNumberReader containing the script to be processed.
items.translation: lineNumberReader - 包含待处理脚本的 LineNumberReader。

items.source: blockCommentEndDelimiter - the end block comment delimiter.
items.translation: blockCommentEndDelimiter - 块注释的结束分隔符。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O errors
items.translation: IOException - 在发生 I/O 错误时

items.source: ignoreFailedDrops - whether or not to continue in the event of specifically an error on a DROP statement.
items.translation: ignoreFailedDrops - 是否在遇到特定 DROP 语句错误时继续执行。

items.source: blockCommentStartDelimiter - the start block comment delimiter
items.translation: blockCommentStartDelimiter - 块注释的起始分隔符

items.source: blockCommentEndDelimiter - the end block comment delimiter
items.translation: blockCommentEndDelimiter - 块注释结束分隔符

items.source: resource - the resource from which the script was read.
items.translation: resource - 读取脚本的资源。

items.source: separator - the statement separator in the CQL script (typically ";").
items.translation: separator - CQL 脚本中的语句分隔符（通常为 ";"）。

items.source: a String containing the script lines
items.translation: 包含脚本行的`String`

items.source: continueOnError - whether or not to continue without throwing an exception in the event of an error.
items.translation: continueOnError - 在发生错误时，是否继续执行而不抛出异常。

items.source: This value may be supplied as the separator to executeCqlScript(CqlSession, EncodedResource, boolean, boolean, String, String, String, String) to denote that an CQL script contains a single statement (potentially spanning multiple lines) with no explicit statement separator. Note that such a script should not actually contain this value; it is merely a virtual statement separator.
items.translation: 该值可作为 `separator` 参数传递给 executeCqlScript(CqlSession, EncodedResource, boolean, boolean, String, String, String, String)，以表明 CQL 脚本包含单个语句（可能跨越多行），且没有显式的语句分隔符。请注意，此类脚本实际上不应包含该值；它仅是一个虚拟的语句分隔符。

items.source: Within the script, the provided commentPrefix will be honored: any text beginning with the comment prefix and extending to the end of the line will be omitted from the output. Similarly, the provided blockCommentStartDelimiter and blockCommentEndDelimiter delimiters will be honored: any text enclosed in a block comment will be omitted from the output. In addition, multiple adjacent whitespace characters will be collapsed into a single space.
items.translation: 在脚本中，提供的 `commentPrefix` 将被遵循：任何以注释前缀开头并延伸至行尾的文本都将从输出中省略。同样，提供的 `blockCommentStartDelimiter` 和 `blockCommentEndDelimiter` 分隔符也将被遵循：包含在块注释中的任何文本都将从输出中省略。此外，多个相邻的空格字符将被合并为单个空格。

items.source: Within the script, the provided commentPrefixes will be honored: any text beginning with one of the comment prefixes and extending to the end of the line will be omitted from the output. Similarly, the provided blockCommentStartDelimiter and blockCommentEndDelimiter delimiters will be honored: any text enclosed in a block comment will be omitted from the output. In addition, multiple adjacent whitespace characters will be collapsed into a single space.
items.translation: 在脚本中，提供的 `commentPrefixes` 将被遵循：任何以这些注释前缀开头并延伸至行尾的文本都将从输出中省略。同样，提供的 `blockCommentStartDelimiter` 和 `blockCommentEndDelimiter` 分隔符也将被遵循：任何包含在块注释中的文本都将从输出中省略。此外，多个相邻的空格字符将被合并为单个空格。

items.source: Used if neither a custom separator nor the DEFAULT_STATEMENT_SEPARATOR is present in a given script.
items.translation: 当给定脚本中既没有自定义分隔符，也没有DEFAULT_STATEMENT_SEPARATOR时使用。

items.source: Lines beginning with the comment prefix are excluded from the results; however, line comments anywhere else — for example, within a statement — will be included in the results.
items.translation: 以注释前缀开头的行将被排除在结果之外；然而，出现在其他位置（例如语句内部）的行内注释将包含在结果中。

items.source: Lines beginning with one of the comment prefixes are excluded from the results; however, line comments anywhere else — for example, within a statement — will be included in the results.
items.translation: 以注释前缀开头的行将被排除在结果之外；然而，出现在其他位置（例如语句内部）的行注释将包含在结果中。

items.source: Mainly for internal use within the framework.
items.translation: 主要用于框架内部。
